searchText: Cc <@848181786763984926> 👆 can anyone help to calculate “probability of reorg” vs “no of confirmation/blocks” ? I didn’t found anything which gives detailed calculation on this for e.g 6 block after given block will have x% probability of reorg, etc. not sure which is correct channel to ask this question, any help is much appericiated:). Probability probably isn't quite accurate. The probability of a random reorg approaches 0 very fast as time since block grows. Within seconds you are very near 0. However, this is only speaking about reorgs in a healthy network not under attack, which is rather uninteresting. Things become *far* more interesting when you have network health problems like a global network partition, or you have an active attacker mining a shadow chain. Unfortunately, the "probability" of a reorg under these scenarios becomes *incredibly* dependent on the specifics of that scenario. For a network partition, the probability of a reorg is basically 100% for those on the side of the network with less miners for example. Under an attack, it depends entirely on how much hashing power the attacker has.
